latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Instantly turn images or text into animated videos via a free cloud service.

- Upload images or text to create animated videos; supports PNG, JPG, MP4, GIF up to 200MB.
- Automatic setup with 100 free credits valid for 7 days; uses a simple token system.
- Cloud rendering with GPU acceleration delivers 1080p MP4 video in 1–2 minutes.
- Handles common workflows: quick edits, batch processing, and iterative previews.
- Includes session management, export, file upload, credit check, and robust error handling.
- User-friendly: guides you through upload, prompt, and export with helpful inline feedback.
